overview: A world-class personal portfolio for Mohammad Mohsin Shah — Full Stack Developer & UI/UX Designer from Shopian, Kashmir, India. Features a dark-themed, animation-rich, interactive showcase with hero section, skills display, project portfolio, testimonials, and contact form.
features: Hero section with animated gradient and particle effects
Interactive skill cards with glassmorphism effects
Project showcase grid with hover animations
Contact form with validation and success/error feedback
Smooth scroll animations with Motion library
Fully responsive design for all devices
